verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs say the platform runs vision, image generation, video generation and speech models alongside LLMs. They name specific categories: Vision & OCR multimodal models, Whisper speech recognition and text-to-speech, and FLUX, Stable Diffusion and text-to-video. This covers all three modalities the story asks about on one platform. Missing for 10: endpoint-level docs showing how to call image, audio and vision models (e.g., whether they work through the OpenAI-compatible API), and independent or hands-on corroboration that these non-text models work in practice.
